title: OpenAI is finally merging ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs
description: OpenAI is merging the Chat and Work tabs in ChatGPT, starting with a test group of select users. ChatGPT and Codex will draw tokens from the same allowance pool.

title: Apple Watch's AI features for rewinding and recapping conversations begin beta testing
description: Apple's Audio Intelligence features, including Live Rewind and Siri Recaps, have entered beta testing for developers in iOS 27.3. They are conversation-related features for Apple Watch.

title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing...something with third-party AI apps
description: On its earnings call, Apple's CFO pointed to possible revenue from third-party apps and partnerships tied to AI. No details were given.

title: Lumentum CEO touts 'enormous' opportunity in massive AI connectivity deal with Marvell
description: Marvell agreed to acquire optical-components maker Lumentum in a roughly $115 billion fixed-ratio stock deal aimed at AI data center connectivity. Marvell shares fell about 13% and Lumentum's nearly 19% on the news.

title: Oracle files to sell $20 billion in new stock, bonds to finance AI buildout
description: Oracle filed to raise $10 billion in common stock and $10 billion in senior notes to fund its AI buildout. Its shares fell about 8.8% on the day.

title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
description: South Korea's record 2027 budget includes 4.7 trillion won to develop a sovereign AI model. It also funds a broader push into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.
